metadata.audit_scope: Complete codebase audit of AdvisorIntelligence page and subcomponents

files.file: Main page component (v5). Partner AUA analytics dashboard with firm selector, 3-tab layout (Distribution, Advisors, Books), PartnerAnalytics header panel, and ErrorBoundary per tab.
Barrel export for AdvisorIntelligence component.

Comprehensive type definitions (v2). Partner/Firm types, NNA metrics, time series, snapshot, filters, client growth, tax breakdown, header metrics, partner analytics with nested drill-down and time machine, cumulative charts, leaderboard, advisor book, rolling flows. Includes type guards (hasTimeMachine, hasCities, hasClients, hasFlows) and helper functions.

Distribution tab. Dual-mode: Snapshot (donut + time machine + bell curve histogram) and Continuous (stacked area chart). Cohort toggle (GEO/ADV), metric toggle (AUA/NNA/CLA), drill-down into states->cities and architects->clients. Uses ApexCharts (lazy loaded) for donut, Recharts for area/bar/histogram.

Advisors tab. Architects/Implementors toggle controls entire tab. Rolling Flows line chart (NNA/Inflows/Outflows x 30d/90d/1Y windows) + Leaderboard table (3M/6M/1Y/2Y/3Y trailing windows). Top 3 highlights panel. Click leaderboard row to toggle chart line.

Books tab (exported as BooksTab). Individual advisor book drilldown. Firm admin sees advisor selector, summary table, AI executive summary, headline numbers, tax intelligence, income/fees, portfolio composition, engagement metrics. Client detail sub-view. Uses useAuth for role-based display.

Asset Intelligence tab. Cumulative NNA trend chart (4 view modes: AUA/NNA/GEO/ADV) + snapshot table with AUA breakdown by dimension. Dimension selector (Advisors, Geographic, Account Attributes groups). Not currently wired into main page tabs.
Permanent header panel above all tabs. Donut chart (4 views: AUA/NNA/GEO/ADV), time machine (quarterly snapshots), bell curve distribution, drill-down navigation, partner firm selector dropdown.
Header metrics display — total AUA, NNA periods, client counts, quarterly breakdowns.
AUA composition donut/radial chart component.
AUA trend stacked area chart — rolling 12M NNA data visualization.
Dimension selector dropdown for grouping snapshot data (architect, region, tax_status, etc.).
Metric selector for NNA breakdown (NMNC, NMEC_NA, NMEC_SA, inflow, outflow, net).
Client detail drilldown page — individual client view with portfolio balance, AI summary, time series panels.
Barrel export for ClientDetailPage.
Client detail specific types.
AI-generated executive summary panel for individual client.
Portfolio balance visualization panel.
Time series chart panel for client AUA/NNA history.
Barrel export for client detail panels.

page_structure.tab: Dual-mode tab: (1) Snapshot mode — ApexCharts donut with segment legend, time machine strip for quarterly comparison, bell curve histogram with percentile lines (P10/P25/Median/P75/P90), cohort toggle (GEO/ADV), metric toggle (AUA/NNA/CLA), drill-down into states->cities and architects->clients. (2) Continuous mode — stacked area chart with hero metrics and legend, window selector (3M/6M/1Y/2Y/3Y/Max), asset toggle.

Architects/Implementors toggle controls entire tab. Top 3 highlights panel. Rolling Flows line chart (metric: NNA/Inflows/Outflows, window: 30d/90d/1Y) with per-advisor lines. Leaderboard table (3M/6M/1Y/2Y/3Y trailing windows) with search, sortable columns (name, AUA, NNA, growth%, new clients), click-to-toggle chart lines.

Individual advisor book drilldown. Book/Client view toggle. Advisor selector dropdown (from leaderboard data). AI Executive Summary panel (Sparkles icon). Headline numbers (AUA, accounts, clients, fee rate, income yield). Tax Intelligence panel (taxable/deferred/free breakdown with pie chart). Income and Fees panel. Portfolio Composition panel (allocation pie chart, expense ratio, holdings concentration). Engagement Metrics panel (flows, trading activity, tenure). Client list with search and click-to-detail. Uses useAuth for role-based UI.

lifecycle_and_state.state_management: Main page uses React Query (TanStack Query) for partner-analytics fetch. Tabs use mix of React Query (AdvisorsTab) and useEffect+useState (ClientsTab, AssetIntelligenceTab). All data from S3 static files via portal-proxy.
lifecycle_and_state.ui_state: - activeTab: 'distribution' | 'advisors' | 'books' — managed by useTabNavigation hook - selectedFirmId: string — partner firm selector (default '49financial') - Distribution: viewStyle ('snapshot'|'continuous'), cohort ('geo'|'adv'), metric ('aua'|'nna'|'cla'), timePeriod, drilldown state, window - Advisors: advisorRole ('architects'|'implementors'), flowsMetric, flowsWindow, leaderboardWindow, selectedAdvisors, sortField, sortDirection, search - Books: viewMode ('book'|'client'), selectedAdvisor, selectedClient, search
lifecycle_and_state.data_flow: 1. Page mounts -> partner-analytics query fires (loads donut/distribution/metrics for all 4 views + time machine periods) 2. PartnerAnalytics component renders header with donut, bell curve, time machine strip 3. Tab content loads tab-specific data on mount (cumulative chart, leaderboard, rolling flows, clients tab, etc.) 4. Drill-down: click donut segment -> nested data (cities within state, clients within architect) 5. Time machine: click quarterly strip -> view historical snapshot for that period

known_limitations.limitation: AssetIntelligenceTab exists as a component but is not currently wired into the main page tab navigation
All data from S3 static files — refreshed daily by bd-portal-publisher and bd-portal-advisor-publisher Lambdas
ClientDetail sub-page panels (AISummaryPanel, PortfolioBalancePanel, TimeSeriesPanel) exist but may have limited data population depending on gold layer output

audit_summary.completeness: 100% — all files in directory accounted for, all API calls traced, all tabs documented
